name: @red-cup-engineering/dated-state-writing-service
description: Writes and reads dated state records at <root>/<YYYY>/<MM>/<DD>/<YYYY-MM-DD>-<service>-<type>.<extension>, keyed by a caller-supplied recordedAt timestamp instead of a content hash. Use when a service needs to publish or retrieve one of its own dated snapshots under the house data/state date-tree.
